title: Run integration tests against real Modal deployment
Verify probes are evaluated during forward pass on full context
description:
Create tests to verify that probes score ALL tokens (including prompt tokens), not just generated tokens. 

Current concern: Need to ensure probes are applied during the forward pass so they capture the full context, not just at generation time.

Proposed test approach:
1. Run the same game with varying prompt lengths/content
2. Check that probe scores change appropriately with different prompts
3. Verify prompt_token_scores array has the expected length
4. Possibly: Compare probe scores on identical generated text with different prompts - scores should differ

This ensures the bug fix from commit 6ace012 is working correctly and probes truly score the full conversation context.
